name: zmodel_material_reset_defaults
description: zModel_Material::ResetDefaults clears transient material references, preserves high flag bits, and restores the original default color/scalar fields.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this material helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel material/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x480c40 validates preserving material flag bits 0xf800 while setting low flags to 0x00ff, clearing current texture, unknown_14, user tag, and cycle pointer, setting packed color 0x7fff, setting RGB floats to 255.0, and setting both scalar fields to 0.5.
The native smoke verifies the reset values and preservation of high material flag bits before exercising adjacent material lookup helpers.
